Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer relied on the DuckDuckGo “Search Assist” snippet (which incorrectly suggested Del Norte County, California) instead of opening and verifying authoritative sources like Wikipedia/IMDb. This introduced/confused conflicting birthplace information (California vs. Colorado) and, despite Planner’s repeated instructions, WebSurfer kept performing similar searches without extracting or reconciling data from credible pages. The failure to verify and synthesize from reliable sources led to a stalled process and risked an incorrect answer.
